extraction_notes: The supplied six-page manufacturer datasheet is SE30150B, N-Channel Enhancement-Mode MOSFET, Revision A, dated Dec 2014; all six pages were examined.

The electrical-characteristics heading specifies TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. The datasheet identifies the manufacturer as ShangHai Sino-IC Microelectronic Co., Ltd.; the job manufacturer label is preserved as SINO IC.
Threshold voltage was transcribed separately as 1 V minimum, 1.7 V typical, and 3 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA.
Every published RDS(on) condition/value was retained: 2.1 mOhm typical at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 25 A; 1.6 mOhm typical and 1.9 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V and ID = 30 A.
Ciss, Coss, and Crss were converted from pF to F and retain VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, and f = 1 MHz conditions. The table values are 7032 pF, 898 pF, and 743 pF respectively.

The datasheet publishes Qg = 80 nC, Qgs = 19 nC, Qgd = 38 nC, switching timing values, IDSS maximum = 1 uA at VDS = 24 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum = 100 nA at VGS = 20 V, RthetaJC maximum = 2 degC/W, and RthetaJA maximum = 50 degC/W; these fields are not represented in the strict schema and are recorded only here.

Curve points are conservative manual digitizations of visible grid locations from Figures 1 through 4 on p. 4. No points were interpolated or extrapolated beyond the plotted traces. Figures 5 and 6 were examined but not transcribed because they are thermal-transient and safe-operating-area limit plots rather than the device characteristic families represented by the strict schema.
No body-diode forward-voltage specification or usable body-diode forward-characteristic plot is published in the supplied datasheet, so body_diode is null.
